properties.name: STILL OPEN 2026-10-03: external_dependency stores `features` and `components` as ONE comma-joined string, so a feature whose text holds a comma is read back as several. The second lossy shape of fact:re-declaring-a-dependency-drops-the-resources-description-2026-09-23, carried here because that fact's first shape is fixed
properties.source: fix program item 8, --call on a scratch store with the branch binary
properties.statement: Measured on the item 8 branch after its re-declare fix: declaring dep:x with features ["the jot skill: /jot, /note and /log-issue"] reads back from reconcile_dependencies as ["the jot skill: /jot", "/note and /log-issue"]. crates/reflow2-core/src/depends.rs writes `features` with join(",") and declared_dependencies splits on ",". First seen 2026-09-24 on flo2 (0.70.0), recorded inside the 2026-09-23 description-drop fact. Item 8 fixed the description drop and invalidated that fact, so this shape is recorded on its own to stay open. Not fixed here: storing a list needs a schema decision (a list property, or an escaped join), outside item 8.
